question: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ and $g:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=2x-1$ and $g(x)=x^2+3$. Find $(g\circ f)(x)$ and $(f\circ g)(x)$.
explanation:
Composition $g\circ f$
Using $(g\circ f)(x)=g(f(x))$,
$$g(f(x))=g(2x-1)=(2x-1)^2+3.$$
Therefore,
$$(g\circ f)(x)=4x^2-4x+4.$$

Composition $f\circ g$
Using $(f\circ g)(x)=f(g(x))$,
$$f(g(x))=f(x^2+3)=2(x^2+3)-1.$$
Therefore,
$$(f\circ g)(x)=2x^2+5.$$

Final result
$$(g\circ f)(x)=4x^2-4x+4,\qquad(f\circ g)(x)=2x^2+5.$$
